verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Datalab returns its conversion results as Markdown, HTML, or JSON, and that it stores files. That is the product's core processing output, not a documented way to export all account data (stored files, pipeline configurations, checkpoints, history) before leaving. Open-source models and on-prem deployment are adjacent exit options, not a data-export capability, so no credit applies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
